A classic Vegas spot — large, bustling, and full of history. It tends to draw a diverse crowd, and the expansive layout has plenty to explore.

Known for its beautiful Italian-themed architecture and high-quality gaming spaces, this one’s great if you want an immersive atmosphere that feels like more than just a casino.
